pattern: SELECT .+ FROM ( SELECT professional_id.* AS .* ) AS \w+_count ON .+ WHERE\s+num_[A-Za-z0-9]+ \>\= \d+
correction: Join the tables correctly and perform the count after the join, use GROUP BY for aggregation, and move the WHERE clause to filter the results after the grouping.

metadata.description: This rule identifies queries that incorrectly join tables and perform counts in a subquery, instead of joining the tables correctly and performing the count after grouping.
